plan.fixed_background_scope: Inherited WorldClim cloud and remote monsoon background fields remain fixed; conditional regional solver, not fully independent global forecast.
plan.purpose: One fixed statically stable separation of modeled surface and zonal thermal patterns; paired against both historical wind closures, no fitting.

success.aggregation: Equal three regions, paired rainfall loss ratios; expose every regional regression; no individual rain veto.
success.interpretation: Process support only. Compare separated candidates to original-wind controls; single-pattern cases are extra exact controls and explicit context. No independent validation/adoption.

plan.predicted_signature: Allow lower and upper horizontal thermal gradients to differ in direction while preserving dry static stability and exact dry/water continuity; actual rainfall gain is primary.
plan.fixed_approximations: A=modeled Tsl, B=modeled zonal EBM Tz, both common101325Pa references smoothed500km; raw T=[B+(A-B)*sigma^a]*sigma^kappa with200K floor. Nominal a=1/(-log(.75)) from existing dry lower-layer depth. Warm anomaly a capped by dry-adiabatic stability using Rd,cp1004,g.
